description:
Port upstream's per-line clear strategy (pi-mono tui.ts:1102).

Currently our renderer emits line + \e[m\e[K (paint then clear-to-EOL). Upstream emits \e[2K (erase entire line) BEFORE writing each changed line.

Clear-before is more robust: the row is guaranteed blank before painting, regardless of cursor position or prior content width. Our \e[K only clears from cursor-to-EOL, which depends on the cursor being at column 1 after the move_to_row sequence.

This change naturally falls out of opi-uvo.2 (viewport model) since we'll be building a buffer string with relative cursor movement rather than iodata lists with absolute positioning.
title: Clear-before-paint: use \e[2K instead of \e[K
